raw_text: ALERT: Multiple deepfake videos targeting Taiwan presidential candidates detected across Chinese social platforms and spilling onto Telegram. At least 3 fabricated clips show DPP candidate Lai Ching-te making inflammatory cross-strait statements. Spamouflage-linked accounts are pushing coordinated hashtag campaigns with fabricated polling data showing KMT leading by double digits. Taiwan FactCheck Center has flagged 47 instances in the past 72 hours.
